title: "phenotyping"
author: "Xiaomin"
format: html
editor: visual
---

This document details the process of cleaning, preparing, and analyzing humoral data related to HBV vaccination. The analysis involves several steps, including data import, merging of different batches, handling of duplicates, and integration of metadata. The primary goal is to explore the antibody responses over time, particularly in different age groups and vaccine types.

# Load libraries


# --- Load Data and processing for merge---

```{r}
phenoflow<-read_excel("./data/20260320Pheno_cleandata_table_xy.xls")
phenoflow <- phenoflow |>
  mutate(make.unique = paste(Participant, Visit, sep = "_"))
#elisaMeta <- read_csv("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta.csv")
elisaMeta <- readRDS("./outs/elisa_mergeMeta_with_offsetVisitDates.rds")
elisaMeta <- elisaMeta %>%
  mutate(FirstVisitDate = if_else(Participant == "hbvx-0009" & is.na(FirstVisitDate), 
                                  as.Date("2023-03-01"), 
                                  FirstVisitDate))

```

#-----merge pheno with elisaMeta-----

```{r}
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- full_join(
  phenoflow,
  elisaMeta,
  by = "make.unique",
  suffix = c(".pheno", ".elisa")
) 
  
# 1) Build a clean metadata table from elisaMeta
meta_clean <- elisaMeta %>%
  group_by(Participant) %>%        # or Participant.pheno if that's the name there
  summarise(
    FirstVisitDate    = first(na.omit(FirstVisitDate)),
    Age               = first(na.omit(Age)),
    AgeSplit50        = first(na.omit(AgeSplit50)),
    Sex               = first(na.omit(Sex)),
    SmokingStatus     = first(na.omit(SmokingStatus)),
    Race              = first(na.omit(Race)),
    Ethnicity         = first(na.omit(Ethnicity)),
    BMI               = first(na.omit(BMI)),
    StatusAtEnrollment = first(na.omit(StatusAtEnrollment)),
    Product           = first(na.omit(Product)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2) Join this back to the stitched data
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  left_join(meta_clean,
            by = c("Participant.pheno" = "Participant"),
            suffix = c("", ".meta"))

# 3) Fill NAs in stitched columns from the meta_clean columns
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  mutate(
    FirstVisitDate    = coalesce(FirstVisitDate,   FirstVisitDate.meta),
    Age               = coalesce(Age,               Age.meta),
    AgeSplit50        = coalesce(AgeSplit50,        AgeSplit50.meta),
    Sex               = coalesce(Sex,               Sex.meta),
    SmokingStatus     = coalesce(SmokingStatus,     SmokingStatus.meta),
    Race              = coalesce(Race,              Race.meta),
    Ethnicity         = coalesce(Ethnicity,         Ethnicity.meta),
    BMI               = coalesce(BMI,               BMI.meta),
    StatusAtEnrollment = coalesce(StatusAtEnrollment, StatusAtEnrollment.meta),
    Product           = coalesce(Product,           Product.meta)
  ) %>%
  select(
    -ends_with(".meta")   # remove helper columns
  )
#remove space in column names
names(phenoflow_elisa_Meta) <- gsub(" ", ".", names(phenoflow_elisa_Meta))

#define final elisa for every participant
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  group_by(Participant.elisa) %>%
  arrange(Visit.elisa, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    Elisa.final = {
      # last non-NA elisa.HBsAb in this participant
      vals <- elisa.HBsAb
      vals[rev(seq_along(vals))[which(!is.na(rev(vals)))[1]]]
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
#define memoryTtets and Activate.cTfh %in CD4
phenoflow_elisa_Meta <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  mutate(
    memDRB01 = `DRB0101+`*DRB01_nonnaive/100,
    memDRB07 = `DRB0701+`*DRB07_nonnaive/100,
    Activated.cTfh.CD4 = Activated.cTfh*cTfh/100,
    CD8.GZMB = `CD8.GZMB+...39`+ `CD8.GZMB+...40`
  ) 

```

#-----T-Tets plots timecourse, DRB0701### naive group all DRB0701-----

```{r}
###naive group all DRB0701
# 1) dplyr::filter data
df_plot <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Tets %in% c("DRB07_=HLA","DRB07_?HLA","DRB07_≠HLA"),
    StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive"
  )

# 2) Labels for last visit per participant
df_labels <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Participant.pheno) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno == max(Visit.pheno)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3) Average per visit
df_avg <- df_plot %>%
  group_by(Visit.pheno) %>%
  summarise(
    DRB0701_mean = mean(`DRB0701+`, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 4) Compute p-values for each visit vs v1w0
#    Assumes Visit.pheno is something like "v1w0", "v1w4", etc.
baseline_visit <- "v1w0"

# paired t-test per visit vs baseline (by Participant.pheno)
df_pvals <- df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno %in% c(baseline_visit)) %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB0701_base = `DRB0701+`) %>%
  right_join(
    df_plot %>% select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB0701 = `DRB0701+`),
    by = "Participant.pheno"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno.y != baseline_visit) %>%   # keep non-baseline visits
  group_by(Visit.pheno.y) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      # match baseline and current visit within participant
      x <- DRB0701_base[!is.na(DRB0701_base) & !is.na(DRB0701)]
      y <- DRB0701[!is.na(DRB0701_base) & !is.na(DRB0701)]
      if (length(x) > 1) {
        t.test(y, x, paired = TRUE)$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Visit.pheno = Visit.pheno.y)

# 5) Prepare text positions for p-values (slightly above mean line)
df_ptext <- df_avg %>%
  left_join(df_pvals, by = "Visit.pheno") %>%
  mutate(
    label = ifelse(is.na(p_value),
                   NA_character_,
                   paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))),
    y_pos = DRB0701_mean + 0.4 * diff(range(DRB0701_mean, na.rm = TRUE)) # adjust offset
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(label))  # keep only rows that will be labeled

# 6) Plot
pnaive <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = `DRB0701+`)) +
  geom_point(color = "lightgray") +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant.pheno), alpha = 0.5, color= "lightgray") +
  geom_line(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = DRB0701_mean, group = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = DRB0701_mean),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_labels,
    aes(label = Participant.pheno, x = Visit.pheno, y = `DRB0701+`),
    size = 2,
    color = "lightgray",
    max.overlaps = Inf,        # let ggrepel consider all labels
  box.padding = 0.4,         # more padding around labels
  point.padding = 0.3,
  min.segment.length = 0,    # always draw segments
  force = 1.5               # increase repulsion
  ) +
  # add p-values as text above the mean line
  geom_text(
    data = df_ptext,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = "DRB0701+ (% of CD4 T cells)",
    title = "DRB0701 over visits"
  ) +
  ct2

######################################################DRB0701+ memory phenotype over time(naive)
df_long <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB07_naive, DRB07_nonnaive,
         StatusAtEnrollment, Tets) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("DRB07_naive", "DRB07_nonnaive"),
    names_to = "Subtype",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype = factor(
      Subtype,
      levels = c("DRB07_naive", "DRB07_nonnaive"),
      labels = c("Naive", "Non-naive")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Visit.pheno != "NA",
    Tets %in% c("DRB07_=HLA","DRB07_?HLA","DRB07_≠HLA"),
    StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno) %>%
  # keep only participant-visit pairs where Naive + Non-naive > 0
  dplyr::filter(sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup()

# Aggregate and convert to percentages per visit
df_pct <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Visit.pheno, Subtype) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent = 100 * Value / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

ggplot(df_pct, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = Percent, fill = Subtype)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = " % of DRB0701+",
    fill = "Subtype",
   
    title = "DRB0701 memory phenotype over visits"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
 ct2
```

```{r}
df_long <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, DRB01_naive, DRB01_nonnaive,
         StatusAtEnrollment, Tets) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("DRB01_naive", "DRB01_nonnaive"),
    names_to = "Subtype",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Subtype = factor(
      Subtype,
      levels = c("DRB01_naive", "DRB01_nonnaive"),
      labels = c("Naive", "Non-naive")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Visit.pheno != "NA",
    Tets %in% c("DRB01_=HLA","DRB01_?HLA","DRB01_≠HLA"),
    StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno) %>%
  # keep only participant-visit pairs where Naive + Non-naive > 0
  dplyr::filter(sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) %>%
  ungroup()

# Aggregate and convert to percentages per visit
df_pct <- df_long %>%
  group_by(Visit.pheno, Subtype) %>%
  summarise(Value = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    Percent = 100 * Value / Total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

  labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = " % of DRB0101+",
    fill = "Subtype",
   
    title = "DRB0101 memory phenotype over visits"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
```

#-----T-Tets plots Ab correlation-----

```{r}

# 1. CLEANING & PREPARATION
# Ensure no hidden tabs/spaces in the Tets column
df <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  mutate(Tets = trimws(Tets))

# 2. DATA EXTRACTION FUNCTION
prep_cor_data <- function(df, tets_values, drb_col, visit_pheno, visit_elisa, label) {
  # phenotype at specified Visit.pheno
  pheno <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      Tets %in% tets_values,
      Visit.pheno == visit_pheno
    ) %>%
    select(Participant.pheno, DRB = all_of(drb_col))
  
  # ELISA at specified Visit.elisa
  elisa <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(Visit.elisa == visit_elisa) %>%
    select(Participant.elisa, elisa = elisa.HBsAb)
  
  # join by participant and add label for faceting
  dat <- pheno %>%
    inner_join(elisa, by = c("Participant.pheno" = "Participant.elisa")) %>%
    mutate(Plot_Label = label)
  
  return(dat)
}

# 3. BUILD COMBINED DATASET
d1 <- prep_cor_data(df, c("DRB01_=HLA","DRB01_?HLA","DRB01_≠HLA"), "memDRB01", "v2w1", "v2w4", "DRB01 (v2w1) vs Ab (v2w4)")
d2 <- prep_cor_data(df, c("DRB01_=HLA","DRB01_?HLA","DRB01_≠HLA"), "memDRB01", "v3w1", "v3w4", "DRB01 (v3w1) vs Ab (v3w4)")
d3 <- prep_cor_data(df, c("DRB07_=HLA","DRB07_?HLA","DRB07_≠HLA"), "memDRB07", "v2w1", "v2w4", "DRB07 (v2w1) vs Ab (v2w4)")
d4 <- prep_cor_data(df, c("DRB07_=HLA","DRB07_?HLA","DRB07_≠HLA"), "memDRB07", "v3w1", "v3w4", "DRB07 (v3w1) vs Ab (v3w4)")

all_dat <- bind_rows(d1, d2, d3, d4)

# 4. CALCULATE STATS FOR LABELS
stats_labels <- all_dat %>%
  group_by(Plot_Label) %>%
  summarize(
    r_val = round(cor(DRB, elisa, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson"), 2),
    p_val = format.pval(cor.test(DRB, elisa)$p.value, digits = 2),
    label_text = paste0("r = ", r_val, "\np = ", p_val),
    # Position text at the top-left of each panel
    x_pos = min(DRB, na.rm = TRUE), 
    y_pos = max(elisa, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# 5. FINAL FACETED PLOT
ggplot(all_dat, aes(x = DRB, y = elisa)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = stats_labels, 
            aes(x = x_pos, y = y_pos, label = label_text),
            hjust = 0, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, fontface = "italic") +
  facet_wrap(~Plot_Label, scales = "free_x") + 
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    title = "Correlation Analysis: memDRB vs HBsAb",
    x = "memDRB Value (% of CD4 T cells)",
    y = "HBsAb (ELISA)"
  )


```

#---------------activated cTfh of cTfh plots Ab correlation-----

```{r}
# Define the visits you want to process
all_visits <- c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v3w0", "v3w1")
plot_list <- list() # Initialize a list to store plots
# Loop through each visit
for (v in all_visits) {
  
  # 1. dplyr::filter and pull the two columns for the current visit
  cor_data <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
    dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno == v,
           StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive") %>%
    select(Activated.cTfh, Elisa.final) %>%
    drop_na() 
  
  # Check if we have enough data (at least 3 points) to run a correlation
  if (nrow(cor_data) > 2) {
    
    # 2. Run the correlation
    result <- cor.test(cor_data$Activated.cTfh, cor_data$Elisa.final, method = "pearson")
    r_val <- unname(result$estimate)
    p_val <- result$p.value
    
    # 3. Plot
    p <- ggplot(cor_data, aes(x = Activated.cTfh, y = Elisa.final)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
      labs(
        x = "Activated cTfh (% of cTfh)",
        y = "HBsAb (mIU/mL)",
        title = paste("Activated cTfh vs Final HBsAb at", v),
        subtitle = paste0("r = ", round(r_val, 2), 
                          ", p = ", format.pval(p_val, digits = 3))
      ) +
      theme_bw()
    
    # Print the plot so it shows up in your Plots pane
    print(p)
    # Store the plot in the list
    plot_list[[v]] <- p
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping", v, "- not enough data points."))
  }
}
# Save all plots to a single PDF page with 3 rows and 2 columns
ggsave(
  filename = "./figs/Flow_pheno_ActivatedcTfh_Ab_correlation_percentageofcTfh.pdf", 
  plot = marrangeGrob(plot_list, nrow = 3, ncol = 2), 
  width = 8.5, height = 11
)
```

```{r}
    # 2. Run the correlation
    result <- cor.test(cor_data$Activated.cTfh.CD4, cor_data$Elisa.final, method = "pearson")
    r_val <- unname(result$estimate)
    p_val <- result$p.value
    
    # 3. Plot
    p <- ggplot(cor_data, aes(x = Activated.cTfh.CD4, y = Elisa.final)) +
      geom_point(size = 2) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "red") +
      labs(
        x = "Activated cTfh (% of CD4)",
        y = "HBsAb (mIU/mL)",
        title = paste("Activated cTfh vs Final HBsAb at", v),
        subtitle = paste0("r = ", round(r_val, 2), 
                          ", p = ", format.pval(p_val, digits = 3))
      ) +
      theme_bw()
        # Store the plot in the list
    plot_list[[v]] <- p
    # Print the plot so it shows up in your Plots pane
    print(p)
    
  } else {
    message(paste("Skipping", v, "- not enough data points."))
  }
}
ggsave(
  filename = "./figs/Flow_pheno_ActivatedcTfh_Ab_correlation_percentageofCD4.pdf", 
  plot = marrangeGrob(plot_list, nrow = 3, ncol = 2), 
  width = 8.5, height = 11
)
```

#------heatmap showing all correlations above---------
```{r}
# 1. Define corrected metadata variables
cor_vars <- c("Age", "BMI", "Elisa.final")

# 2. Process all three variables and markers in one pipe
all_stats_combined <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive", Visit.pheno %in% all_visits) %>%
  # Select the corrected column name Elisa.final
  dplyr::select(Visit.pheno, all_of(cor_vars), all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  # Pivot markers first
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(target_cols), names_to = "Marker", values_to = "M_Val") %>%
  # Pivot Metadata variables second (includes Elisa.final)
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(cor_vars), names_to = "Variable", values_to = "V_Val") %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(M_Val, V_Val) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Visit.pheno, Marker, Variable) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n() > 3) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(
    r_val = cor(M_Val, V_Val, method = "pearson"),
    p_val = cor.test(M_Val, V_Val)$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Add stars for significance spotting
  dplyr::mutate(stars = cut(p_val, breaks=c(-Inf, 0.001,0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf), labels=c("***", "**", "*", "#"," ")))
# Calculate the largest absolute correlation to keep the scale balanced
max_abs_r <- max(abs(all_stats_combined$r_val), na.rm = TRUE)

# 3. Generate the Heatmap with Diverging Colors
p_heatmap <- ggplot(all_stats_combined, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = Marker)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = r_val), color = "white") +
  # MOVE 'size = stars' INSIDE aes() and add show.legend = TRUE
  geom_text(aes(label = stars, size = stars), 
            color = "black", show.legend = TRUE) +
  
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#084594", mid = "white", high = "#99000d", 
                       midpoint = 0, limit = c(-max_abs_r, max_abs_r), name = "Pearson r") +
  
  # This will now link to the size = stars mapping
  scale_size_manual(name = "p-value", 
                    values = c("***"=3, "**"=3, "*"=3, "#"=2, " "=0),
                    labels = c("***"="p < 0.001","**"="p < 0.01", "*"="p < 0.05", "#"="p < 0.1", " "="ns")) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Variable) + 
  theme_bw(base_size = 5.6) + 
  labs(
    title = "HBVNaive: Phenomarkers correlation with Age, BMI and Final HBsAb",
    x = "Visits",
    y = "PhenoMarkers"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"), 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 4)) +
  # Optional: ensure stars in the legend are easy to see
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = c("***", "**", "*", "#", ""))))


# 4. Save 
ggsave("./figs/Flow_Pheno_Combined_Heatmap_correlations_with_meta.pdf", p_heatmap, width = 5, height = 5)

```

#-----------iterations of different flowmarkers over visit plot function----------------------

```{r}

plot_marker_over_visits <- function(df,
                                    marker,
                                    status_group = c("HBVnaive", "HBVimmune"),
                                    baseline_visit = "v1w0",
                                    labels_df = NULL,
                                    y_label = NULL,
                                    plot_title = NULL,
                                    x_limits = NULL) {

  status_group <- match.arg(status_group)

  marker_sym  <- ensym(marker)
  marker_syml <- sym(paste0(as_string(marker_sym), " (% of parent)"))

  # 1) dplyr::filter data
  df_plot <- df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !is.na(Visit.pheno),
      StatusAtEnrollment == status_group
    )

  # 2) Average per visit
  df_avg <- df_plot %>%
    group_by(Visit.pheno) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_val = mean(!!marker_sym, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # 3) Paired t-test vs baseline
  df_pvals <- df_plot %>%
  dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno %in% c(baseline_visit)) %>%
  select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, base = !!marker_sym) %>%
  right_join(
    df_plot %>% select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, value = !!marker_sym),
    by = "Participant.pheno"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno.y != baseline_visit) %>%   # keep non-baseline visits
  group_by(Visit.pheno.y) %>%
  summarise(
    p_value = {
      # match baseline and current visit within participant
        x <- base[!is.na(base) & !is.na(value)]
        y <- value[!is.na(base) & !is.na(value)]
      if (length(x) > 1) {
        t.test(y, x, paired = TRUE)$p.value
      } else {
        NA_real_
      }
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  rename(Visit.pheno = Visit.pheno.y)

  # 4) P‑value label positions
  df_ptext <- df_avg %>%
    left_join(df_pvals, by = "Visit.pheno") %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(
        is.na(p_value),
        NA_character_,
        paste0("p = ", signif(p_value, 3))
      ),
      y_pos = mean_val + 1 * diff(range(mean_val, na.rm = TRUE))
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(label))

  # Default labels if not provided
  if (is.null(y_label)) {
    y_label <- rlang::as_name(marker_syml)
  }
  if (is.null(plot_title)) {
    plot_title <- paste0(rlang::as_name(marker_sym), " over visits (", status_group, ")")
  }

  # Labels df
  if (!is.null(labels_df)) {
    labels_df <- labels_df %>%
      mutate(value = !!marker_sym)
  } else {
    labels_df <- df_plot %>%
      mutate(value = !!marker_sym)
  }

  # 5) Plot
 p <- ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = !!marker_sym)) +
  geom_point(color = "lightgray") +
  geom_line(aes(group = Participant.pheno), alpha = 0.5, color= "lightgray") +
  geom_line(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = mean_val, group = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = df_avg,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = mean_val),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    size = 5
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = df_labels,
    aes(label = Participant.pheno, x = Visit.pheno, y = !!marker_sym),
    size = 2,
    color = "lightgray",
    max.overlaps = Inf,        # let ggrepel consider all labels
  box.padding = 0.4,         # more padding around labels
  point.padding = 0.3,
  min.segment.length = 0,    # always draw segments
  force = 1.5               # increase repulsion
  ) +
  # add p-values as text above the mean line
   geom_text(
    data = df_ptext,
    aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = y_pos, label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "red",
    fontface = "bold.italic",
    vjust = 0,
    size = 3
  ) +
 labs(
    x = "Visit",
    y = y_label,
    title = plot_title
  ) +
  ct2 
 print(p)
  }

markers <- colnames(phenoflow_elisa_Meta)
markers <- markers[-c(1:3,5, 17:30, 32, 33, 39, 40, 41:83)]
plots_naive <- lapply(
  markers,
  \(m) plot_marker_over_visits(
    df = phenoflow_elisa_Meta,
    marker = !!sym(m),       # Add the bang-bang operator here
    status_group = "HBVnaive",
    baseline_visit = "v1w0"
  )
)
# 1. Define the layout (3 columns x 7 rows = 21 plots per page)
# 'grobs' is your list of plots
# 'nrow' and 'ncol' define the grid
# 'top' can be a dynamic title or NULL
multi_page_plot <- marrangeGrob(
  grobs = plots_naive, 
  nrow = 6, 
  ncol = 2, 
  top = "HBV Naive Marker Analysis"
)

# 2. Export to PDF
# Adjust width and height for a standard A4 or Letter feel (e.g., 8.5 x 11 or 12 x 18)
ggsave(
  filename = "./figs/Flow_Pheno_HBVnaive_Markers_overtime_Grid.pdf", 
  plot = multi_page_plot, 
  width = 12, 
  height = 18
)
```

#------heatmap showing all flowmarkers fc over visits-----

```{r}
# Define the baseline and visits
baseline_visit <- "v1w0"
all_visits <- c("v1w0", "v1w1", "v2w0", "v2w1", "v3w0", "v3w1")

# 1. Create a Baseline-only dataframe
df_baseline <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive", Visit.pheno == "v1w0") %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant.pheno, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(target_cols), names_to = "Marker", values_to = "Baseline_Val")

# 2. Process all visits against that baseline
foldchange_stats <- phenoflow_elisa_Meta %>%
  dplyr::filter(StatusAtEnrollment == "HBVnaive", Visit.pheno %in% all_visits) %>%
  dplyr::select(Participant.pheno, Visit.pheno, all_of(target_cols)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = all_of(target_cols), names_to = "Marker", values_to = "Current_Val") %>%
  # Match each participant/marker back to their specific v1w0 value
  dplyr::inner_join(df_baseline, by = c("Participant.pheno", "Marker")) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(Current_Val, Baseline_Val) %>%
  group_by(Marker, Visit.pheno) %>%
  summarise(
    # Calculate log2 of the ratio of the means
    log2FC = log2(mean(Current_Val) / mean(Baseline_Val)),
    # Correct Paired T-test
    p_val = if(unique(Visit.pheno) == "v1w0") 1 else {
      if(n() > 2) t.test(Current_Val, Baseline_Val, paired = TRUE)$p.value else NA_real_
    },
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(stars = cut(p_val, breaks=c(-Inf, 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, Inf), 
                     labels=c("**", "*", "#", " ")))

# 3. Plot (Your existing ggplot code)
p_fc_heatmap <- ggplot(foldchange_stats%>% dplyr::filter(Visit.pheno != "v1w0"), aes(x = Visit.pheno, y = Marker)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = log2FC), color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = stars, size = stars), color = "black", show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#084594", mid = "white", high = "#99000d", 
                       midpoint = 0, name = "Log2 FC\n(vs v1w0)") +
  scale_size_manual(name = "p-value (paired)", 
                    values = c("**"=3, "*"=3, "#"=2, " "=0),
                    labels = c("**"="p<0.01", "*"="p<0.05", "#"="p<0.1", " "="ns")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 5.6) + 
  labs(
    title = "HBVNaive: Phenomarkers dynamics over time",
    x = "Visits",
    y = "PhenoMarkers"
  )+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  # Add this to force the stars into the legend correctly
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(label = c("**", "*", "#", ""))))

ggsave("./figs/Flow_Pheno_Marker_FoldChange_overtime_heatmap.pdf", p_fc_heatmap, width = 5, height = 5)

```
